title: TimeActivity

Id.description: Product: ALL Description: Unique Identifier for an Intuit entity (object). [br /]Required for the update operation. Required: ALL Filterable: ALL

SyncToken.description: Product: ALL Description: Version number of the entity. The SyncToken is used to lock the entity for use by one application at a time. As soon as an application modifies an entity, its SyncToken is incremented; another application's request to modify the entity with the same SyncToken will fail. Only the latest version of the entity is maintained by Data Services. An attempt to modify an entity...

MetaData.description: Product: ALL Description: Descriptive information about the entity. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

CustomField.description: Product: QBW Description: Custom field (or data extension). Filterable: QBW

AttachableRef.description: Specifies entity name of the attachment from where the attachment was requested

domain.description: Product: ALL Description: Domain in which the entity belongs.

status.description: Product: ALL Description: System status of the entity. Output only field.[br /] Filterable: ALL

sparse.description: Product: ALL Description: True if the entity representation has a partial set of elements. Output only field.

TimeZone.description: The timezone from where the time activity is entered, unused in QBO and QBW

TxnDate.description: The date of the time activity.

EmployeeRef.description: Specifies the employee whose time is being recorded.

VendorRef.description: Specifies the vendor whose time is being recorded.

OtherNameRef.description: Specifies the Payee whose time is being recorded.

PayrollItemRef.description: The payroll item determines how much the employee should be paid for doing the work specified by the Item Service Id. In order for the Time Activity data to be transferred to the employee payroll data, the Employee must have the property UseTimeEntry set.

ProjectRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Project identifier References to the project this line is associated with

TimeChargeId.description: The ID of the related TimeCharge transaction.

BillableStatus.description: Billable status of the time recorded

Taxable.description: True if the time recorded is both billable and taxable.

HourlyRate.description: Hourly bill rate of the employee or vendor for this time activity. [b]QuickBooks Notes[/b][br /] [i]Unsupported field.[/i]

CostRate.description: Hourly cost rate of the employee or vendor for this time activity.

BreakHours.description: Hours of break taken between start time and end time. [b]QuickBooks Notes[/b][br /] [i]Unsupported field.[/i]

BreakMinutes.description: Minutes of break taken between start time and end time. Valid values are 0 - 59. [b]QuickBooks Notes[/b][br /] [i]Unsupported field.[/i]

BreakSeconds.description: Seconds of break taken between start time and end time. Valid values are 0 - 59.

Description.description: Description of work completed during time activity.

TimeActivityEx.description: Internal use only: extension place holder for TimeActivity.

HoursInEmployeeTimeZone.description: True if the start, end hours are already with company/employee time zone offset. Couple of TimeActivity API integrations are already submitting start, end hours with right company/employee time zone offsets. Such integrations will pass this attribute as true to avoid company time zone offsets by TimeActivity API.

description: A record of time worked by a vendor or employee.
